findings.category: I3/I4/I12: historical snapshot loss on corrupt store
findings.description: upsert_published_snapshot called _load_json (returns None on parse failure) + _load_published_store (coerces None to empty store). A corrupt published_recommendations.json would be silently reset to an empty store on the next upsert, wiping all historical immutable snapshots (26112, 26113, etc.).
findings.fix: F1: upsert_published_snapshot now returns 'corrupt' and does NOT write when the target file exists but is not a parseable published store. Only a truly missing file triggers first-publication creation.

findings.category: I5: non-atomic write leaves corrupt store on mid-write crash
findings.description: _write_json used open(path,'w') + json.dump: the 'w' mode truncates the target file immediately. A crash/kill between truncate and dump leaves a corrupt (empty or partial) file. G2 is the root enabler of G1.
findings.fix: F2: _write_json now writes to a same-directory tempfile (tempfile.mkstemp), fsyncs, then atomically os.replace over the target. No truncation of the live file. On failure, temp is unlinked and the exception propagates.

adversarial_scenarios.note: scheduler targets next_issue(26112)=26113; publisher upsert hits existing 26113 with different seed → conflict → I3/I12 preserved; no overwrite.
D1 UNIQUE + INSERT OR IGNORE makes only first write authoritative; local upsert: first creates, second conflicts or is unchanged; CI concurrency.group serializes jobs.
workflow isolates D1 write (set +e, exit 0 on fail); local JSON publish is independent; no half-publish of recommendation content.
publisher is pure: re-run with same inputs → same upsert status; deterministic seed (P4-1) ensures same snapshot hash.
upsert appends by issue key; out-of-order does not overwrite earlier issues.
build_snapshot requires dict primary; snapshot_hash handles missing numbers via .get; malformed → None hash → conflict on next upsert (original preserved).
upsert recomputes hash; mismatch → conflict (original preserved).
app.js reads static recommendations.json (publisher-written); selectPrimary reads is_primary flag; does not recompute.
wrangler pages deploy public uploads static files only; no scheduler/publisher trigger; guard script does not run generation.
P4-1 publication_seed verified: same identity → same seed → same snapshot; verified in test_p41_deterministic_rng (100/100 same-process, 20/20 cross-process).

defense_in_depth: D1 INSERT OR IGNORE + UNIQUE(target_issue,strategy,idx) one-period lock
upsert conflict preserves original snapshot (existing I2/I12)
publisher fail-closed on 0/multiple primaries or conflict (existing)
--safe mode: top-level exceptions → exit 0, no crash in CI
not_a_defect: history lag targeting already-published issue: conflict protection handles it (no overwrite)
